title: Re-cap CI jobs over 80% of their timeout, and set measured caps
why: A job near its timeout fails at random on a slow day.
note: Coordinator 12:10 CST. Debt jobs-over-80pct-of-cap: windows-guard and windows-guard-2 at 99%, windows-merge* at 82-94%, checks-guard at 84%, shell-macos at 83%. checks-macos-b and checks-merge-install still have the provisional 60 min cap after 29-30 green runs. A verdict change, so it needs a review. Sighting (runner 8 via the coordinator, 15:16 CST Nov 9): in batch 69 checks-guard used 27 of 27 min and one attempt hit the cap; checks-macos-b ran 26 of 31 and checks-windows-rest 26 of 28. A cap hit turns a batch red and costs a rebuild. Fix to weigh: split checks-guard, or give it headroom (skill ci-hygiene). Coordinator filed it as ci-guard-headroom; folded here.
